se habuit.

page.notes: The first line was printed as a continuation from the previous page. Long s has been transcribed as plain s throughout, and ff as ss in "Illustriss." and "honoratissimi". The word "serenissimo" is uncertain: the scan shows only "sereniss." with a mark, so it is marked [?]. The line-end hyphens in "sena-tus" and "subscri-pturum" are kept as printed. The catchword "unio" stands alone at the right below the last line; it is partly cut off, so it is not certain.
